mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the decision is interpreted by markets as a signal of impending rate hikes, which reduces the present value of future equity cash flows and drives negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat when FEDFUNDS is above 5.25% for at least 4 consecutive months prior to the prediction window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) coinciding with a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) creates a labor-market strength signal that anticipates a 60-day S&P 500 bull run by lowering risk aversion.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.05 over the 60-day horizon or SPX 60-day returns are negative when both proxies show the same direction of change.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 5% month-over-month suggests accelerating economic demand, which typically precedes a 5-day S&P 500 upmove as market participants anticipate supply chain adaptation and production ramp-ups.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when INDPRO growth is >5%.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of contracting consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL < 240) reduces the Fed's disinflationary bias, lowering real discount rates and supporting a 20-day S&P 500 upmove.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when CPIAUCSL remains below 240 for >3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 12-month change of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% in a month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain higher policy rates and depressing 60-day S&P 500 forward expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.1) when CPIAUCSL 12-mo change > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in job openings (HOUST) accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) forms a labor market overhang signal that weakens equity valuations over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when both proxies show the described pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 1-month change of new home sales (not available in the provided proxies - skip this) -- instead: A 2-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rebound above trend suggests cyclical bottoming, which often precedes a 5-day S&P 500 upmove.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO shows bottoming pattern (decline then rebound)
failure_condition: 5-day returns are flat or negative when INDPRO shows a clear bottoming pattern.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS is above 5% and UNRATE is simultaneously below 4%, the combination of higher policy costs and low labor market friction creates a risk-off environment that is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
regime_hint: contractionary policy and loose labor market
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite the combined signal being present for at least 4 consecutive prediction windows.
